description: This PHP class defines LDAP employee selector mappings. It extends Symfony's ParameterBag to manage attribute mappings for LDAP employees, including conversion to array, extracting attributes from an LDAP entry, and creating instances from array configurations. The class enforces validation of mapping fields and attribute names.

classes.name: LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping
classes.description: Handles LDAP employee attribute mappings with validation, conversion, and extraction functionalities.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all attribute mappings in array form.

methods.name: getAllAttributeNames
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute names from the mappings.

methods.name: extractAttributeValuesToSearchFilterParam
methods.description: Extracts attribute values from an LDAP entry to populate LDAPEmployeeSearchFilterParams based on the current mappings.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an instance of LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping from an array of mapping configurations with validation.
